summary: U Power Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into subscription agreements with four non-U.S. purchasers for 9,756,100 Class A ordinary shares at $1.64 per share, aggregate proceeds of $16.0 million, under Regulation S. The offering closed on August 3, 2026, and proceeds will fund hydrogen energy solutions and strategic acquisitions for intelligent data centers in Thailand. This is a routine capital-raising transaction (equity issuance) not constituting a special situation; no buyback, tender, or restructuring is involved. The board approved the transaction, and no advisors or unusual terms were disclosed.
